additional_sources.title: Heidelberg Materials UK: Material transported and CO2 emissions 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official operator PDF provides explicit 2024 tonnes CO2 per year by UK business line and transport mode plus a UK total. These are transport/business-line absolute emissions, not individual facility or cadastral parcel emissions; total and components share a double-count group.

additional_sources.title: EPD International: Rugby Cement Plant CEM I 52,5N EPD-IES-0014296
additional_sources.guard: Verified product EPD for Rugby Cement Plant. GWP values are per declared unit of 1000 kg cement and remain product life-cycle intensity context; they are not annual facility emissions and cannot be promoted to a parcel.

additional_sources.title: Breedon Group plc Annual Report and Accounts 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official annual report gives avoided-emissions project context including Wickwar solar >20 tCO2e/year expected saving and Raisby electric mixer 4.5 tCO2e saving over a three-month trial. Avoided savings are not facility emissions.

additional_sources.title: Environment Agency: VPI Immingham LLP permit application EPR/BJ8022IZ/V014
additional_sources.guard: Environment Agency notice identifies Immingham CHP Power Plant, Rosper Road, North Lincolnshire, DN40 3DZ and permit variation for post-combustion CO2 capture. It strengthens onshore England facility identity/binding only and supplies no observed 2024 GHG quantity.

additional_sources.title: Environment Agency 2024 data on regulated businesses in England
additional_sources.guard: Official EA publication confirms 2024 regulated-business datasets including pollution inventory information for each release type. Dataset authority/source surface only; no row-level emissions are invented when binary tables are not directly parsed.

guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CANDIDATE: Explicit scope, gas, quantity, unit, period and provenance are required. Business-line or transport totals remain non-parcel and nested totals/components are double-count protected.
guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CONTEXT: Product EPD or intensity metrics remain context and cannot silently become annual facility emissions.
guard_contract.BINDING_CANDIDATE: Permit/address/facility data supports identity/binding only; no emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SOURCE_UPGRADE: Avoided emissions, dataset metadata or inaccessible binary rows cannot become measured facility emissions without compatible explicit row evidence.

web_research_basis: Fresh public internet research on 2026-07-27 using official Heidelberg Materials UK, EPD International/CEMEX, Breedon and GOV.UK/Environment Agency sources. Heidelberg 2024 transport CO2 rows are explicit. EPD and avoided-savings figures are isolated as context. VPI permit and EA regulated-business publication strengthen onshore source/binding discovery. PDF screenshot calls were attempted for analyzed PDFs; cache/size limitations are recorded, with machine-readable/indexed text used and zero OCR or graph inference.
